title: Your foods
subtitle: Every food you log comes from this list
empty: Nothing yet. Add the foods you eat often and logging them will take three taps.
create_subtitle: An ingredient or a whole meal — the values are yours to enter
edit_subtitle: Changing these values never rewrites what you have already logged
delete_confirm_body: It disappears from your list and from search. What you have already logged with it is untouched.
reference_help: Enter the values as they appear on the label. When you log this food you will type how much you ate, not a multiplier.
calories_suggested: Worked out from the macros above. Type over it if the label says otherwise.
calories_suspicious: The macros suggest about {expected} kcal. Worth a second look.
